def my_find(s1, s2, start):
    if not s2:
        return start
    for i in range(start, len(s1)):
        if i + len(s2) > len(s1):
            break
        if s1[i:i+len(s2)] == s2:
            return i
    return -1

def main():
    s1 = input().strip()
    
    pos = my_find(s1, "at", 1)
    s2 = s1[:pos] + '@' + s1[pos+2:]
    
    i = my_find(s2, "dot", 1)
    last = 0
    ans = ""
    while i != -1 and i + 3 <= len(s2):
        ans += s2[last:i]
        ans += '.'
        last = i + 3
        i = my_find(s2, "dot", last)
    ans += s2[last:]
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
